column1: # Zodiac's words for a screen reader (fm1-reader): the text sent <TAB> what to say.

column2: welcome to zodiac. turn select to choose a sign. turn the four knobs. hold a bottom button. turn algo for more.
twelve signs. each is a picture and a piece that plays itself, never the same way twice. leave it running.
the wheel. turn select for the wheel. rest on a sign and it opens. preset steps straight to the next.
a button each. f x to rec are the twelve signs, aries to pisces. the lit one is playing.
a d j's hands. knobs one to four: low pass, high pass, echo, reverb. all the way down, the piece as it is.
the bottom left button. press it and the sign answers. the ram bleats, the lion roars, the water pours.
the bottom row. every other button there is an effect for as long as you hold it. hold several at once.
try this. hold the ninth white button from the left, tape stop. press another sign. let go. the piece winds up to speed.
play and save. octave down stops and starts. octave up keeps the four knobs for next time.
from outside. any midi note makes the sign answer. program change zero to eleven chooses the sign.
